hexanal.content_correction_note: CONTENT CORRECTION 2026-08-27 (Wave R). PREVIOUS VALUE: band 15.0-180.0 ppb, geometric midpoint 51.96 ppb, with OAV 3-40. WHAT IT MATCHED IN THE SOURCE: NOTHING. No hexanal concentration and no hexanal OAV in the thesis is within two orders of magnitude of those numbers; the band is retired as unsourced. SOURCE: Yaozheng Liu, "Flavor Chemistry of Pea Proteins", MS thesis, North Carolina State University, 2021 (NC State Institutional Repository item db647868-5ffe-4621-9f11-bbc4db357406); published as Liu, Cadwallader & Drake (2023), Food Chemistry 406:134998, doi 10.1016/j.foodchem.2022.134998. TABLE/ROW: Table 2.7 'Concentrations of positively identified aroma-active compounds of pea proteins', row `Hexanal 2` = 4318 +/- 481, 3360 +/- 274, 2445 +/- 212, 6052 +/- 776, 6383 +/- 409, 11203 +/- 2216, 12181 +/- 4237, 52454 +/- 34133, 2533 +/- 804 ug/L. NEW BAND = that inter-lot min/max (2445-52454). Table 2.7 quantifies 9 of the 24 commercial pea proteins: samples 4, 12, 13, 14, 16 (isolates) and 1, 2, 19, 22 (concentrates), per Table 2.3. Column order in the row quotations below is 1, 2, 4, 12, 13, 14, 16, 19, 22. OAV RANGE 543-11656 is Table 2.8, row `Hexanal`, against the thesis's own 4.5 ug/L water threshold -- which happens to equal this repo's hexanal ODT, so the OAVs transfer without rescaling. UNITS BASIS: ug/L OF THE REHYDRATED 10%-SOLIDS (w/w) SLURRY, read as ppb on the aqueous slurry (rho ~ 1 kg/L). It is NOT a per-gram-of-powder basis and NOT a headspace concentration. DI-WATER CALIBRATION CAVEAT: quantified by HS-SPME-GC-MS/MS external standard curves with response factors (R^2 > 0.95), and the curves were built by spiking the authentic standards into DI WATER, not into the protein matrix (thesis section 2.9: "SPME extracts were prepared as described earlier ... except that pea protein solutions were replaced with 5 mL DI water and were spiked with known compounds at five different levels"). Protein binding of the analyte is uncorrected, so every value here is a LOWER BOUND on total analyte in the slurry. NOT SCORED, recorded for honesty: the ISOLATE-ONLY subset (samples 4, 12, 13, 14, 16) is 2445-12181 ug/L, geometric mid 5457. The 52454 top of the scored band is sample 19, a CONCENTRATE and the lowest-protein sample of the panel (52.8 wt% protein, Table 2.3).

content_verification.quoted_quantification: Five (5) grams of rehydrated pea protein samples (10 % solids (w/w), 0.5 g pea protein and 4.5 g water) were added to 20 mL SPME vials in triplicate. Internal standards ... 2-methyl-3-heptanone at 1010 ppm, ... 2-ethoxy-3-isopropyl pyrazine at 10 ppm, and ... heptanal-d14 at 1004 ppm ... For standard curves, pea protein solutions were replaced with 5 g DI water and were spiked with known compounds (Table 4) at five different levels ... Concentration (ng/g) = (area_target / area_IS) x Rf x mass_IS (ng) / sample mass (g).
content_verification.quoted_values: Table 4 (ng/g of the rehydrated 10 %-solids protein, n = 2, nine commercial pea proteins): hexanal 2445-52454, mean 11214; nonanal 0.188-3.42, mean 0.887.
content_verification.quantification_verdict: HS-SPME-GC-MS/MS with internal standards, response factors and DI-water standard curves. The bundle's hexanal 11320 ppb is the nine-product mean of Table 4 (11214 ng/g, 1 % apart); its nonanal 0.802 ppb is within 10 % of the Table 4 mean (0.887 ng/g; the bundle's value was taken from the 2021 thesis). The 'uncertainty_pct' values (363 %, 326 %) are the spread across the nine products, not measurement error.
